title: Subscription & Expense Tracker for Students in India
metaDescription: Track student discounts, shared plans, pocket money and UPI AutoPay in one place. Set up Essara in about 10 minutes and catch renewals before full price starts.
h1: How do students in India keep track of subscriptions, pocket money and renewals?
summary: Students in India often pay for several small recurring things at once: a student music or video plan, a phone recharge, a food app membership and a few UPI AutoPay debits, all from a monthly allowance that is easy to overspend. A manual tracker such as Essara lets you add each one yourself, shows upcoming renewals and sets a monthly budget with a daily spending limit, without connecting to your bank.

sections.heading: Student discounts can quietly turn into full-price plans
paragraphs: Most student offers are time-limited, and the renewal is where people get caught. Spotify's Premium Student plan is open to eligible college and university students for up to four years, but you must renew your eligibility every year. About four weeks before the discount ends, Spotify emails instructions to re-verify through SheerID. If you miss the renewal, Spotify's help page says your Premium continues automatically at the full price.

So the date a discount ends matters as much as the price. Write it down the day you sign up, and check your inbox a month before. If you already see full price, Spotify's explanation is that the discount was probably not renewed before the 12 months ended. You can still renew from your account page and resubscribe to Premium Student for the discounted price on your next payment.

sections.heading: Shared plans and pocket money
paragraphs: Splitting a streaming plan with a sibling or hostel friend is common, but it muddies your totals. Log only your share of the bill, so the monthly figure matches what actually leaves your account.

Pocket money usually goes out in many small amounts: a recharge, a few delivery orders, a bus pass. Add your allowance as income when it arrives, set a monthly budget, and use the daily spending limit to see what you can spend each day.

sections.heading: Cancelling, and checking that it actually stopped
paragraphs: Subscriptions bought through Google Play are cancelled in the Google Play app: open subscriptions, select the one you want to stop and tap Cancel subscription. Google says you keep access for the period you have already paid for and are not charged at the next billing date. Uninstalling the app does not cancel it.

On an iPhone, open Settings, tap your name, tap Subscriptions, tap the subscription and choose Cancel Subscription. To confirm it stuck, reopen that screen: no Cancel button, or an expiry message in red text, means it is already cancelled. If a family member's Apple Account is on the receipt, only that person can cancel it.

sections.heading: Stopping UPI AutoPay and card billing
paragraphs: In Google Pay, tap your profile picture, choose Autopay, open the Live tab, pick the mandate and choose Pause autopay or Cancel autopay. You will be asked for your UPI PIN, and you can set a start and end date when pausing. Labels differ by app version, so update the app if you cannot see the option.

Google's page also notes that for a mandate above ₹15,000 your UPI PIN is asked again when each payment is due, and that loan-related mandates cannot be cancelled through Google Pay, so you need to ask the lender. Cancel the service itself as well, because stopping the debit alone does not end the subscription.

Card subscriptions have no single list to cancel from. Cancel inside the merchant's account first, and if charges continue, ask your card issuer to stop the recurring e-mandate. Keep the cancellation email with its date.

sections.heading: How tracking renewals in Essara helps
paragraphs: Essara is a manual tracker. You add each subscription with its amount, billing cycle and next renewal date, and it shows renewals for the next 30 days and sends a reminder before each one. It does not read your bank, UPI app or SMS, so the list is only as complete as what you enter. For a student plan, enter the date the discount ends as the renewal date.

steps.name: Gather your list
steps.text: Open Google Play subscriptions or the Apple Subscriptions screen, and the Autopay section of your UPI app. Note each item, its price and when it renews.

steps.name: Create your account
steps.text: Sign up at essara.space/signup, or install the Android app from Google Play. The same account works on Android, the web app and the installable web app on an iPhone.

steps.name: Add each subscription by hand
steps.text: Enter the name, amount, billing cycle (monthly, quarterly or yearly) and next renewal date. For a student plan, add the date the discount ends.

steps.name: Add UPI AutoPay mandates
steps.text: Copy each mandate from your UPI app's Autopay list into Essara, so upcoming auto-debits show alongside your other renewals.

steps.name: Switch on renewal reminders
steps.text: Check the upcoming-renewals timeline for the next 30 days, and make sure a reminder is set before each renewal.

steps.name: Set your allowance and budget
steps.text: Log your pocket money as income, then set a monthly budget. The app shows what is left to spend and a daily spending limit.

steps.name: Scan your first receipt
steps.text: Scan a canteen or stationery bill with the receipt scanner. It reads the merchant, total and date; review the details before you save. The free plan includes 5 scans a month.

faqs.q: Does a Spotify Premium Student plan switch to full price automatically?
faqs.a: Yes, if you do not renew. Spotify's help page says eligible students must renew every year to keep the discount for up to four years, and if you do not renew at 12 months, Premium automatically continues at the full price. You can renew later from your account page and then resubscribe to Premium Student to get the discounted price again on your next payment.

faqs.q: Can I track student expenses in Essara without linking my bank account?
faqs.a: Yes. Essara is manual: you add expenses, subscriptions and UPI AutoPay mandates yourself. It never connects to your bank or UPI app, never reads SMS and never asks for your UPI PIN.

faqs.q: Why does my UPI AutoPay still debit after I cancelled the subscription?
faqs.a: Cancelling inside the service and cancelling the UPI mandate are two separate steps. Open the Autopay section of your UPI app, pause or cancel the mandate with your UPI PIN, and then check the merchant's account to confirm the subscription itself has ended.

The free plan includes unlimited manual expense tracking, 3 months of history, 5 receipt scans a month and 5 subscription slots. Paid plans unlock unlimited history, scans and tracking. Check essara.space/pricing for the current prices before you choose.

faqs.q: Can I use Essara on an iPhone?
faqs.a: Essara does not have a native iPhone app. Use the web app at essara.space, which can be installed, with the same account you use on Android.
